dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: Hello, are you here for the hot-air balloon ride too?

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: Yeah. And for me, it's not just the balloon riding experience. Their operating principles are fascinating in their own right!

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: Based on my observations and experiences, despite the balloons being rather slow, they still have Fontainian aircraft beat both in terms of altitude control and navigation...

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: But my shooting skills are complete trash, so I'd prefer not to bug Mr. Pixica too often.

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: I'll go chat with him once I've taken down enough notes.

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of which! Because I've been helping residents with some reconstruction efforts, Mr. Pixica gave me priority access to hot-air balloon rides!

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: But my shooting skills are complete trash, so I'd better not bug him too often.

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: I'll go chat with him once I've taken down enough notes.

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: Before I came here, someone told me that the people of the Flower-Feather Clan aren't used to interacting with outsiders. But it doesn't seem that way at all.

dialogues.speaker: Freycinet
dialogues.text: A little fella even gave me some delicious cake. Want to try some?
